content.text: {"core": "Creation is the point where something still-forming gets declared finished and fixed. In Wisdom, that declaring lands on deep knowing itself — the kind that sits with the unresolved, letting it ripen. Overdone, the landing comes too soon: whatever has not yet settled gets stamped complete before it has finished becoming, and the stillness that slow knowing needs goes dry.", "sheetLine": "Stamped finished too soon, the ripening stopped before it was done."}
